name: Red shutter bay house
features: Narrow red facade, tall shutters, single projecting balcony and modest cornice.

name: Stacked side verandahs
features: Offset stacked balconies and green shutters; ornate photographed lattice becomes two plain rails.

name: Cream screened verandah
features: Broad cream verandah, slender rectangular posts, green shutters and shallow projecting roof.

name: Narrow polygon bay house
features: Vertically stacked corner bay, compressed to a three-sided projection rather than a dense curved screen.

name: Red gallery row house
features: Red masonry, recessed-looking verandah band and continuous upper rails; floor count adapted for density.

name: Ochre corner balconies
features: Ochre plaster, corner balconies and deep eaves; carved screens omitted.

name: Chamfered cream verandah
features: Corner verandah and cream cornice; ornate pierced infill simplified to open horizontal rails.

name: Blue projecting window house
features: Projecting shuttered bay and stepped parapet inspired by the photographed residential facade.

name: Oxide pilaster house
features: Two-storey red frontage, tall plaster pilasters and deep sill/cornice bands; no palace-scale ornament.

name: Red green-shutter terrace
features: Original narrow residential interpretation of the photographed red-and-green gallery language, with a setback terrace; not a landmark replica.

name: Compact pink concrete house
features: Flat concrete roof, one solid balcony, offset upper block and bold rectangular awning.

name: Stacked cream balcony block
features: Stepped left balconies, horizontal accent strips and contrasting side service wall.

name: Narrow peach service spine
features: Narrow stacked corner balconies and vertical service/window strip; high-rise source compressed to five floors.

name: Brick twin balcony block
features: Two balcony stacks, central bay and flat roofline; broad apartment source compressed to a reusable six-storey block.

name: Beige clipped-corner apartments
features: Angled corner balconies, offset side windows and a simple concrete cap.

name: Broad sand balcony building
features: Broad shallow balconies and strong horizontal slab bands; grilles reduced to solid parapets.

name: Yellow alternating bay block
features: Alternating projecting balcony/window bays and dark red horizontal accents.

name: Grey asymmetric apartment stack
features: Offset box balconies, grey/white concrete planes and a small rooftop tank silhouette.

name: Narrow blue terrace home
features: Compact two-storey frontage, tall side fin, slim balcony and flat terrace.

name: Peach corner shop apartments
features: Angled corner, closed ground-floor shutters, blank sign panels and compact upper windows.

name: Twin-crown shop gallery
features: Two roof parapet crowns, two shop bays and paired upper balconies; source complex reduced to one building.

name: Cream shutter-front block
features: Large closed shutters, vertical accent strip and a narrow upper residential balcony.

name: Three-shop white walkup
features: Three different-width shopfronts and blank sign surfaces, with offset windows above.

name: White corner balcony shops
features: Corner balcony stack, blue side accent and two closed storefronts under blank signboards.

name: Blue masonry sheet-roof home
features: Compact blue masonry, opaque shutter, low corrugated sheet roof and small supported awning; debris and exaggerated wear omitted.

name: Brick home with upper room
features: Modest mixed-height brick construction, small upper room and simple low roof, inspired by individual masonry units in the photographed Tiljala lane.

name: Low plaster home with roof extension
features: Low plaster masonry and staggered sheet-roof extension, inspired by the foreground units in the Kolkata housing photograph.
